raw:
Agent Name: Validation_Expert  
Step Number: 9  
Reason for Mistake: The Validation_Expert confirmed the actual enrollment count as 100 participants without thoroughly cross-checking the data on the NIH website. The correct enrollment count for the clinical trial on H. pylori in acne vulgaris patients from Jan-May 2018, as listed on the NIH website, is 90 participants, not 100. The mistake likely occurred because the Validation_Expert failed to verify the specific enrollment period (Jan-May 2018) and instead relied on the overall enrollment count listed on the clinical trial page. This oversight led to an incorrect conclusion being validated and accepted by the team.
